This portal checks every raised PO against how well it is actually selling.
Single Concept articles are checked against their own stock-cover days (STR); Multi Concept articles are ranked against similar styles’ sell-through (PDSTR / quartile).

Retain = healthy. Reduce Qty = Single Concept, high STR, still viable at a smaller qty. Cancel = confirmed dead stock, Single or Multi Concept. Watch List = borderline peer ranking, or a data pattern like a broken size curve — needs a human call, not an automatic one.

This portal checks every raised PO against how well it is actually selling.
Single Concept articles are checked against their own stock-cover days (STR); Multi Concept articles are ranked against similar styles’ sell-through (PDSTR / quartile).
